collection.description: A beautifully woven straw hat has washed up near the encampment.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A large, beautifully woven straw hat has washed up near the encampment. Nobody knows who made it. It is, everyone agrees, far too fine to have been made by anyone on this side of the island.

choices.label: Use It as a Cooking Strainer

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) wears it everywhere for a week. It doesn't go with (his/her) mask at all. (He/she) doesn't care.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text:
It makes an excellent strainer. The camp's stew has never been so clear. A small amount of grumbling is heard from people who wanted a turn wearing it.
The Heathens' village gains food. \(no effect\)
